test_title: PYST 11: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Only two people sit between A and G when counted from the right of A. Only two people sit between G and C. Only three people sit between A and F. E sits to the immediate left of D.

How many people sit between C and E when counted from the right of C?
solution:
**Given: **A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are sitting around a circular table facing the center.

1) Only two people sit between A and G when counted from the right of A.

2) Only two people sit between G and C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2ca4121dfd17e8d1c10e24b4bcf9de40ecabb3a0c724288bd47226d2641c643.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5778e322789250b3fc8c7a796458ae32ef7ec7b8f9fc37da6df4b16ed954f7f7.png] 

3) Only three people sit between A and F.

4) E sits to the immediate left of D.

After positioning all only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6540ee783562487c37b7c08003b4824b8de2066076f25c9a0879264b5901234f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f78983546b2f247bafa502f5e7d7103d0261a59bd3ded02fd7dbb1d82e42d5d.png] 

Thus, one person sit between C and E when counted from the right of C.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
